hypothesis: Instruction count is driven primarily by heap depth and request comparisons, with separate overhead for singleton removal and restoration of a nontrivial heap.

pcvs.name: remaining_heap_depth
pcvs.rationale: Computes the remaining heap depth for the exercised entry sizes of 1 through 12 using cheap comparisons.

pcvs.name: queue_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures residual size-dependent heap maintenance and list storage costs.

pcvs.name: requires_restoration
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes singleton removal from replacement and heap restoration.

pcvs.name: requires_comparisons
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes removals that invoke request comparisons from the smallest heaps.
